description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/column_nonuniform_1d/rules/sedimentation_jh2010_flux_D_lev: the compound D(W*q, lev) replaced by the rule's five-region makearray (layer 1; layer 2; the interior stencil faq over [3,6]; layer 7; the no-inflow top layer 8). Every binding loads fixture.esm (NLEV bound to 8 at the import edge, the stretched ze from the shared mesh library), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST with zero unlowered rewrite-target ops in evaluation position, zero surviving metaparameter names, the free-name geometry array dz surviving as index references, and the lev_nodes axis folded to size 9. Surviving apply_expression_template nodes for the match-less face, velocity, reconstruction and mesh templates are expected (reference-preserving loader, esm-spec 9.6.4); the template registry they resolve against is part of the golden. The expanded document exceeds the 64 KiB checked-in threshold, so the golden is pinned as expanded.golden.sha256 (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh).
